descriptionByLocale.it:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position The Patient Safety Intern will embark on a growth journey upon joining Roche. The intern will develop fundamental knowledge in Pharmacovigilance and Safety Risk Management throughout the lifecycle of a product and enabling safe access to innovative treatments for the patients, ensuring optimal beneﬁt-risk balance for a therapeutic product. At the end of the internship, the intern should achieve the following;
• To understand and apply pre-marketing pharmacovigilance requirements in Asia Paciﬁc
• To understand and apply post-marketing pharmacovigilance requirements in Asia Paciﬁc
• To understand EU Good Pharmacovigilance Practice (GVP) and its implementation in global processes
• To be able to accurately assess and independently complete some basic Pharmacovigilance requirements
• Demonstrate soft skills, project management and presentation skills Qualiﬁcations:
• Currently pursuing a degree in Biological Sciences, Chemistry, Life Sciences, or Pharmaceutical Science.
• Preferably a student who can commit from July 2026 to December 2026 .
• Willing to work at our Singapore oﬃce located in Paya Lebar Quarter . Who we are A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact. Let’s build a healthier future, together. Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.
